d: We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and performance-driven Corporate Performance Specialist to support the development, implementation, and monitoring of corporate performance management frameworks.

The successful candidate will play a key role in tracking organizational performance against strategic objectives, managing corporate KPIs, analyzing performance trends, and providing actionable insights to improve business effectiveness and organizational results.

This role will involve close collaboration with senior management and cross-functional departments to ensure alignment between corporate strategy, departmental targets, and actual business performance.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in performance measurement, KPI management, business analytics, management reporting, and continuous improvement.
Support the development and implementation of corporate performance management frameworks and measurement systems.
Establish, monitor, and evaluate corporate KPIs in alignment with organizational strategies and business objectives.
Coordinate with departmental heads to define performance targets, metrics, and measurable deliverables.
Monitor corporate and departmental performance against approved targets, strategic plans, and operational objectives.
Collect, validate, consolidate, and analyze performance data from different business units and departments.
Prepare periodic corporate performance reports, dashboards, scorecards, and management presentations.
Conduct performance gap analysis to identify areas of underperformance and recommend corrective actions.
Track the progress and effectiveness of corporate strategic initiatives and business improvement programs.
Facilitate periodic performance review meetings with relevant stakeholders and follow up on agreed action plans.
Analyze performance trends, identify potential risks, and highlight opportunities for organizational improvement.
Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency in corporate performance measurement and reporting.
Support the implementation of Balanced Scorecard frameworks and other performance management methodologies.
Coordinate with Finance, HR, Operations, Sales, and other departments to ensure alignment of performance indicators.
Develop and maintain performance tracking tools, reporting templates, and KPI documentation.
Support senior management in evaluating organizational effectiveness and achievement of strategic objectives.
Recommend improvements in performance monitoring processes, reporting systems, and organizational accountability.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field. MBA or relevant master's degree will be an advantage.
4–7 years of experience in corporate performance management, strategic planning, business analysis, or performance reporting.
Strong understanding of corporate KPIs, performance measurement frameworks, and business scorecards.
Experience in implementing or monitoring Balanced Scorecard methodologies will be preferred.
Proven ability to analyze business performance data and identify performance improvement opportunities.
Experience in preparing management reports, executive dashboards, and performance presentations.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools.
Understanding of corporate strategy, business planning, and organizational performance management.
Excellent analytical, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to engage with senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple performance reporting requirements.
Accuracy and timeliness of corporate performance reporting.
Effectiveness of corporate KPI monitoring and tracking.
Achievement of departmental and organizational performance targets.
Timely identification and reporting of performance gaps.
Progress of strategic initiatives and improvement action plans.
Quality of performance analysis and management recommendations.
Effectiveness of performance review and reporting processes.
Improvement in organizational accountability and performance transparency.
Opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and corporate management.
Exposure to strategic planning and organizational performance initiatives.
Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to organizational effectiveness and business excellence.

d: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

We are seeking an experienced compliance leader to serve as Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Coinbase's Abu Dhabi-based subsidiary. This is a founding role within our Compliance organization: you will build the AML/CTF/PF/Sanctions compliance program in a high-growth market and directly shape our regulatory strategy with the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), balancing compliance with innovation. You will own all aspects of the entity's Anti-Money Laundering program, manage its relationship with the FSRA for AML/CTF purposes, and advise business and product teams on local requirements. The role is supported by Coinbase's global compliance infrastructure.
q: 5+ years of AML/CTF/PF compliance experience, including senior leadership roles.
First-hand knowledge of UAE and Abu Dhabi financial services and AML regulations, including locally required regulatory exams and direct experience liaising with the FSRA or a comparable regulator.
Track record of independently managing day-to-day compliance program operations, including regulatory audits and examinations.

Demonstrated success building a compliance program from the ground up, including developing and administering internal controls in partnership with remote, global teams and senior management across business functions.
Demonstrated experience engaging directly with regulators, vendors, and cross-functional internal stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions; cryptocurrency or fintech experience preferred.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Pay Transparency Notice: The target annual base salary for this position can range as detailed below. Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility and benefits (including medical, dental, and vision).
r: Own identification of AML/CTF/PF and Sanctions requirements applicable to the ADGM entity, maintain policies and procedures as regulatory and business requirements evolve, and ensure ongoing compliance.
Monitor FSRA and UAE regulatory developments and lead implementation of necessary compliance changes with internal stakeholders.

Provide regular updates to senior management and the entity's Board on the AML/CTF/PF/Sanctions program, escalating incidents and material issues promptly, and drive AML/CTF/PF training for local employees and Board members.
Lead day-to-day regulatory communications with the FSRA, including notifications and comment letters, and oversee AML/CTF/PF risk assessments to confirm the adequacy of systems and controls.
Own timely remediation of findings from internal audit, regulatory exams, and self-identified issues.

Partner with Compliance and Product stakeholders to embed compliance into new products and market expansions, and with global teams to keep the AML/CTF/PF control environment consistent and integrated.

d: The PMC Logistics Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing all logistics activities for the ADNOC Offshore project on behalf of ADNOC as PMC. The role ensures safe, efficient, and cost-effective movement of materials, equipment, and personnel between fabrication yards, ports, and offshore sites in compliance with ADNOC standards, HSE requirements, and project schedules.

To plan, coordinate, and manage all logistics activities for the project, ensuring the timely, safe, and cost-effective transportation, storage, customs clearance, and delivery of materials, equipment, and resources to support construction and commissioning activities while maintaining compliance with project schedules, contractual requirements, and HSE standards.
q: At Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related discipline.
Professional certification in logistics or supply chain management is an advantage.
Minimum 15–20 years of experience in logistics management for offshore oil & gas projects.
Strong experience in PMC or EPC roles on major offshore developments.
Extensive experience with marine logistics, offshore campaigns, and heavy-lift operations
r: Develop and implement the Project Logistics Execution Plan (PLEP) for offshore and onshore logistics.
Coordinate marine logistics including vessels, barges, PSV, AHTS, crew boats, and heavy-lift transportation.
Plan and manage material flow from vendors, fabrication yards, ports, and offshore locations.
Ensure alignment of logistics activities with project schedule, construction sequence, and offshore campaigns.
Review and approve EPC Contractors’ logistics plans, procedures, and schedules.
Monitor contractor logistics performance and ensure compliance with ADNOC specifications and contractual requirements.
Interface with EPC Contractors, marine service providers, port authorities, and ADNOC Operations.
Resolve logistics-related issues, bottlenecks, and constraints impacting offshore execution.
Coordinate load-out, sea fastening, transportation, and offshore installation support activities.
Ensure availability and readiness of marine spreads for offshore campaigns.
Review and endorse marine assurance documentation including vessel suitability, certifications, and audits.
Support SIMOPS planning and execution offshore.
Oversee materials management, storage, preservation, and tracking systems.
Ensure proper handling of critical and long-lead items.
Monitor laydown areas, yards, and offshore storage facilities.
Ensure all logistics activities comply with ADNOC HSE MS, marine safety standards, and offshore regulations.
Promote safe logistics practices and participate in risk assessments, JSA, and marine assurance reviews.
Support incident investigations and implement corrective actions.
Monitor logistics costs and support cost control initiatives.
Prepare logistics progress reports, KPIs, and dashboards for ADNOC and PMC management.
Interface closely with Construction, Engineering, Procurement, QA/QC, and HSE teams.
